acceptanceCriteria.details: Literal objectMode true calls infer Entry arrays for async and sync APIs; omitted and literal-false calls infer string arrays; object-mode streams remain assignable to NodeJS.ReadableStream. Runtime async, sync, and stream calls return entry objects.

tests.details: AVA runtime suite: 119 passed, 2 known failures, 0 unexpected failures. Repository TSD suite passed after the documented historical @types/node pin. An independent TSD counterexample file also passed.

regressions.details: Independent type probes covered inline literal true, const-literal options, omitted options, literal false, async, sync, and stream calls. Runtime probes verified entry shape for async/sync/stream object mode and strings for default/false modes.

explainability.details: The leading overloads select a narrow options subtype requiring objectMode: true and return the fast-glob Entry shape. The existing broader overloads remain later fallbacks for omitted, false, and non-literal options.

prReadiness.details: The public type change is localized, exports the underlying entry shape, preserves existing broad and stream contracts, includes runtime and compile-time regressions, reconstructs exactly, and passes runtime, type, lint, and whitespace validation with disclosed historical tooling constraints.
